name: YFlix Local
description: YFlix Local v0.6.0. S2 uses the stabilized VidBolt subset (movie hidden while upstream is stale; TV live Vidlink only). S3 adds native VidNest Videasy + NextGen with runtime identity checks. S4 Videasy remains unchanged and verified.

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 1
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 1 (Multi Source): direct PlayAPI stream API using TMDB IDs. DahmerMovies is filtered after device playback failures.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 2
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 2: current stable VidBolt subset. Movies are hidden while no verified route is live; TV returns only live-probed Vidlink 480p/360p MP4.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 3
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 3 (Original): native VidNest Videasy + NextGen HLS. Each source is opened and duration-checked against TMDB before display.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 4
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 4 (Multi Audio): FilmU Videasy HLS using TMDB+IMDb+title+year identity binding and runtime verification before streams are exposed.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local
